fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry the site's NewsArticle ld+json block verbatim (headline/description/datePublished/author/publisher/keywords etc) plus content (raw article-body HTML) and articleBody (flattened plain text) convenience fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, site-wide feed) carry title/link/creator-style fields plus the full article HTML from <content:encoded>. Upstream fields are passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld for articles, S2-rss for latest headlines, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle block (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Article headline, from the RSS item (latest mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short teaser/dek text. Article mode: ld+json description. Latest mode: RSS item description.

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Site section name, e.g. "Malaysia", "World", "Opinion" (article mode only).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword/tag string from the ld+json block (article mode only).

@context.title: JSON-LD context
@context.description: Raw-passthrough schema.org context URL from the ld+json block (article mode only).

@type.title: JSON-LD type
@type.description: Raw-passthrough schema.org type, always "NewsArticle" (article mode only).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: Article language code, e.g. "en" (article mode only).

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: Raw-passthrough WebPage object with the canonical article @id URL (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Article mode: raw-passthrough ImageObject (url/width/height) from the ld+json block. Latest mode: lead image URL string from the RSS <media:thumbnail> element.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date with timezone offset, from the ld+json block (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date with timezone offset, from the ld+json block (article mode only).

speakable.title: Speakable specification
speakable.description: Raw-passthrough SpeakableSpecification CSS selector hints from the ld+json block (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Raw-passthrough Person object (name) from the ld+json block -- reflects the real byline, not always "Malay Mail" (article mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Raw-passthrough Organization object (name/alternateName/sameAs/logo) from the ld+json block (article mode only).

content.title: Content (raw HTML)
content.description:

. Latest mode: RSS , verbatim.

articleBody.title: Article body (plain text)
articleBody.description: Full article text flattened to plain text (paragraphs joined with blank lines) from the `content` field. Convenience field, not present upstream.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the RSS item (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item GUID, matches the article URL (latest mode only).

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Byline name from the RSS <dc:creator> element -- can be null when the feed omits it (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Plain list of keyword/tag strings, split from the RSS item's single <dc:subject> comma-separated element (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
